Getting There & Back

Your Flights

Fly into Bari to explore the north, then out of Brindisi after your Salento finale — no backtracking required.

✈️
London Gatwick → Bari Karol Wojtyła
easyJet direct · approx. 2h 45m · check easyjet.com for May dates — book early for best fares
OUTBOUND
✈️
Brindisi Papola Casale → London Gatwick
easyJet direct · approx. 2h 40m · Brindisi is 30 mins from Lecce by train — perfect for the end of your Salento leg
RETURN
Transfer Tips
Bari airport to Fasano/Ostuni: taxi ~50 mins (pre-book) or Bari Centrale by shuttle then train south.
Brindisi airport to Lecce: taxi 30 mins or FSE regional train (~45 mins, very cheap).
Between legs, Fasano/Ostuni → Lecce: direct train 1h 15m from Bari direction, under €15pp on Trenitalia.

🏠
Leg 1 — Fasano / Ostuni (Nights 1–2)
The trulli heartland, Polignano cliffs, olive grove countryside
Stay among ancient olive groves between Fasano and Ostuni. Arrive and decompress by the pool, a full day in Polignano with dinner in the sea cave, and a Valle d’Itria tour — or a lazy pool day if you’d rather do nothing.
🌊
Leg 2 — Lecce / Salento (Nights 3–5)
Baroque city, Primitivo wine country, Adriatic beaches
Train south to the Florence of the South. A baroque evening passeggiata, a beach day on Salento’s Caribbean-blue coast, then a Primitivo wine tour through Manduria before a Michelin farewell dinner.

Day 1 · Saturday 24 May 2027

Into the Olive Groves

Land at Bari, transfer south to your Booking.com base between Fasano and Ostuni, and ease into Puglia with the ancient olive-grove countryside and the white hilltop city of Ostuni.

Arrive
LGW→BRI

easyJet direct to Bari. Pre-book a taxi or transfer van south to Fasano or Ostuni — about 50 mins. Drop bags, find your room, breathe in the olive-grove air.

TRANSFER PRE-BOOKED
Early
Afternoon

Relaxation time. You’ve just flown. Drop bags, find your room, and do nothing for a couple of hours. The olive-grove quiet and the Puglian light do something good to the pace of things. If your property has a terrace, use it; if not, Ostuni is 20 minutes away.

NO PLANS REQUIREDJUST ARRIVE
Late
Afternoon

When you’re ready: head to Ostuni — the dazzling white city perched on three hills, visible for miles across the olive plain. Wander the labyrinthine lanes, the Cattedrale di Ostuni, terrace views over the Adriatic. Walk or taxi into Ostuni from most properties in the area. Or save it for Day 2 morning if you’d rather stay put and settle in.

25 MINS FROM BASEOPTIONAL TODAY
Evening

Head into Ostuni for your first proper Puglian dinner. Osteria del Tempo Perso is an Ostuni classic — vaulted stone rooms, fresh orecchiette, local Primitivo. Or wander the lanes and find your own spot. Book a table in advance.

BOOK IN ADVANCEFARM TO TABLE

🏠
Fasano / Ostuni area — Book via Booking.com
Stay among ancient olive groves between Fasano and Ostuni. Look for an apartment, B&B or agriturismo with a terrace or outdoor space — the countryside here is as much the experience as the towns. Day 2 · Sunday 25 May 2027

Polignano & the Clifftop

The full Polignano experience: sea caves, whitewashed alleyways, raw seafood platters — and a cliff-top dinner above the Adriatic.

Morning
Optional

A slow start. If you didn’t make it to Ostuni yesterday, the white city is only 20 minutes away — a quick morning wander before heading to the station. Or simply have a long breakfast and take the late-morning train to Polignano.

NO RUSHOR CHILL ON THE BEACH
Midday

Train to Polignano a Mare — 30 mins from Fasano, under €5. Enter through the Arco Marchesale into the whitewashed old town. Walk Via Commedia delle Mura where poetry is painted onto walls and doors, then find the terrace views at Terrazza Santo Stefano and Ponte Borbonico.

Afternoon

Walk down to Lama Monachile (Cala Porta) — the iconic pebble cove between two limestone cliffs crossed by the old Roman bridge. This is the photo. If time allows, book a 90-minute sea cave boat tour passing Grotta Azzurra and Grotta Arcivescovado. Sunset drink at Terrazza Monachile Bar overlooking the bay.

BOAT TOURS FROM THE PORTFREE BEACH BELOW CLIFFS
Evening
Dinner
🍽
Dinner above the Adriatic — Polignano
Skip Grotta Palazzese (you are paying for the Instagram, not the food). Instead, book a table with a cliff or sea view at Il Bastione or Ristorante Covo dei Saraceni — both sit right above the water and serve excellent Puglian seafood at a fraction of the price. Or pick up fresh seafood from a portside stall and eat on the terrace at Terrazza Monachile as the sun goes down. Walk back through the illuminated old town after dinner.
BOOK ON BOOKING.COMFREE CANCELLATION
Morning
Valle d'Itria

Slow apartment breakfast, then walk or taxi to Fasano or Ostuni station for the FSE regional train north to Alberobello (~40 mins, under €5). No booking needed — buy tickets on the day.

FROM ~€11 ON TRENITALIA
Afternoon

Check in and go straight into the old town. Piazza del Duomo is the centrepiece — the cathedral, the Bell Tower and the Seminary form one of the most complete Baroque ensembles in southern Italy. Then the Basilica di Santa Croce, whose facade is a riot of carved figures that took 150 years to complete. Walk the back lanes: Via Vittorio Emanuele, the Roman amphitheatre in Piazza Sant’Oronzo.

Aperitivo
19:00

Lecce does aperitivo properly. Head to the streets around Piazza Sant’Oronzo for Negroamaro and Fiano poured alongside free cicchetti. The city is illuminated at night and the Baroque buildings glow gold.

PIAZZA SANT’ORONZONEGROAMARO WINE
Dinner
🍝
Alle Due Corti
Old-school Salentine cooking, fresh pasta made daily. The quintessential first-night Lecce dinner — simple, authentic, local.
TRADITIONALBOOK AHEAD
🍽
Osteria degli Spiriti
Elegant osteria with excellent seafood antipasti, orecchiette with white ragù and grilled lamb chops. Slightly more refined for a special evening.
ELEGANTBOOK AHEAD

Day 3 · Monday 26 May 2027

Trulli & the Train South

A slow morning, then an independent trip to Alberobello by train — trulli villages, a local lunch — before the southbound train to Lecce. Arrive into the golden baroque city with the whole evening ahead of you.

Morning
Slow

Slow breakfast, then walk or taxi to Fasano or Ostuni station for the FSE regional train north to Alberobello (~40 mins, under €5). No booking needed — buy tickets on the day.

FSE REGIONAL LINENO BOOKING NEEDED
Midday
🏠
Alberobello — The Trulli Quarter
Explore the UNESCO Rione Monti district at your own pace — no tour group, no fixed schedule. Hundreds of conical stone roofs, some dating to the 14th century. The hobbit-house streets are best before the afternoon heat sets in. Have lunch at Il Pinnacolo or any trattoria on Via Monte Nero before picking up the southbound train to Lecce.
UNESCO WORLD HERITAGEEXPLORE INDEPENDENTLY
Afternoon
Train

Southbound train Alberobello → Lecce (~1h 15m, Trenitalia or FSE). Check in and go straight into the old town. Piazza del Duomo is the centrepiece — the cathedral, Bell Tower and Seminary form one of the most complete baroque ensembles in southern Italy. Walk the back lanes: Via Vittorio Emanuele, the Roman amphitheatre in Piazza Sant’Oronzo.

~€11 ON TRENITALIA
19:00
Aperitivo

Lecce does aperitivo properly. Head to the streets around Piazza Sant’Oronzo for Negroamaro and Fiano poured alongside free cicchetti. The city is illuminated at night and the baroque buildings glow gold.

Day 4 · Tuesday 27 May 2027

Caribbean Blue — Salento Beaches

Your chill day for Leg 2. The Salento coastline in May: impossibly clear turquoise water, white sand, no crowds, unhurried lunch somewhere with your feet in the sand. Leave the agenda at the hotel.

Punta
Prosciutto
🏖
Punta Prosciutto
Wide pristine white sand, flat turquoise water that genuinely looks Caribbean, backed by a pine forest. In May the car park is nowhere near full and the water is warm enough to swim. Designated a protected coastal zone — no development visible from the beach.

Getting there without a car: Pre-book a taxi from Lecce (~45 mins, ~€40 each way) or join a beach day tour from Lecce (several operators run these in summer — check GetYourGuide or Viator closer to the date). The beach is best reached by pre-booked taxi from Lecce (~45 mins) or a beach day transfer.
TAXI ~€40 EACH WAYPROTECTED COASTAL ZONEMAY = NO CROWDS
Or
Consider
🪟
Torre Sant’Andrea — Limestone Sea Stacks
On the Adriatic side: dramatic limestone faraglioni (sea stacks) rising from crystal water, natural rock pools, and a tiny fishing village. More dramatic scenery than Punta Prosciutto, less swimming-friendly sand. Both are about the same distance from Lecce — pick one, or do a morning at one and afternoon at the other.
ADRIATIC COASTDRAMATIC SCENERY
Evening

Back for aperitivo in Lecce — golden hour in a golden city. Tonight is low-key: Trattoria Le Zie for cash-only, no-frills Salentine cooking that feels like eating in a local family’s kitchen, or sit outside at any osteria near Piazza Sant’Oronzo. Save your appetite — big wine day tomorrow.

LE ZIE: CASH ONLYNO RESERVATION NEEDED WEEKDAY
Day 5 · Wednesday 28 May 2027

A Free Morning — Then One Last Dinner

A morning at a different stretch of coast — Torre Sant’Andrea’s limestone stacks and crystal pools. Then a local Primitivo tasting in the afternoon, and a final rustic dinner in Lecce.

Morning
Beach
🏖
Torre Sant’Andrea — Limestone Sea Stacks
Different to Punta Prosciutto — this is the Adriatic side: dramatic faraglioni limestone stacks rising from crystal water, natural rock pools carved into the rock, and a tiny fishing village above. Best for swimming at the pools rather than the sand beach. Pre-book a return taxi from Lecce (~40 mins each way).
TAXI ~€35 EACH WAYDIFFERENT TO DAY 4
Afternoon
Wine

Back in Lecce by mid-afternoon. Pick up a bottle of Primitivo di Manduria or Negroamaro from a local enoteca — Enoteca Mamma Elvira (Via Paladini) is excellent, run by people who know the wines properly. No tour bus required.

TAKE HOME A CASEPIAZZA SANT’ORONZO AREA
What to Look For
Primitivo di Manduria — full-bodied, plummy, 14–16% ABV. Often aged in French and American oak. Try vintage 2019 or 2020 if available — outstanding years.

Negroamaro — darker, more tannic, earthy and savoury. Often blended with Malvasia Nera. A great contrast in the tastings.
Farewell
Dinner
🍽
Farewell Dinner — Rustic Salentine
Osteria degli Spiriti (Via Cesare Battisti) is the pick — stone-vaulted rooms, excellent antipasti, honest local pasta and the kind of unhurried atmosphere that suits a last evening. Or Alle Due Corti again if it was a favourite. End with a slow walk through the illuminated baroque centro storico — the streets empty after 10pm and it’s a different city.
BOOK AHEADRUSTIC & AUTHENTIC
Day 6 · Thursday 29 May 2027 · Departure

Arrivederci, Puglia

A slow morning, then transfer to Brindisi for the flight home.

Morning

Final coffee and a pasticciotto — Lecce’s beloved oval pastry filled with custard cream, invented here and impossible to find as good anywhere else. Sit in Piazza Sant’Oronzo one last time.

Transfer
BDS

Lecce to Brindisi: 30-min taxi (~€30) or FSE regional train (~45 mins, very cheap). Brindisi airport is small and relaxed — arrive 90 mins before departure. Direct easyJet to Gatwick.

TAXI ~€3030 MINS TO AIRPORT
